flags.statement: Labor notionally held 56 seats on the new boundaries.
flags.problem: The 2026 election used the same boundaries as the 2022 election. The Victorian Electoral Commission says the last redivision was completed in October 2021 and took effect on 1 November 2022.
UKMTO Warning 223-26 said the crew were accounted for, not that they were safe. Being accounted for does not rule out injuries.

flags.statement: UKMTO issued 32 numbered warnings and advisories in the first 26 days of November, 26 of them on attacks.
flags.problem: The count omitted Warning 223-26, which UKMTO issued on November 26 and classified as an attack. Including it brings the tally to at least 33 numbered notices, at least 27 of them on attacks.

flags.statement: who ran as the joint candidate of the KMT and the Taiwan People's Party (TPP)
flags.problem: The Taipei City Election Commission lists only the KMT as Chiang's nominating party. The TPP backed the KMT nominee rather than jointly nominating him.

flags.statement: who first won the office in 2022 with 575,590 votes in a three-way race.
flags.problem: The vote total is correct, but Taipei City's official statistical report records 12 candidates in the 2022 mayoral election. Three were leading contenders, not the entire field.

flags.statement: when Chen Shui-bian won a three-way race in 1994
flags.problem: Taipei City's historical account lists four candidates in the 1994 election: Chen Shui-bian, Jaw Shaw-kong, Huang Ta-chou and Ji Rong-zhi. The first three were the main contenders, but Ji was also on the ballot.
